title: rhinanthus serotinus
intro: Rhinanthus serotinus, commonly known as the late-flowering or autumn witch's thimble, is a flowering plant in the family Orobanchaceae, which is a type of parasitic plant that obtains its nutrients by connecting to the roots of other plants. The health benefits of Rhinanthus serotinus include its potential to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe irritated tissues and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Rhinanthus serotinus include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and may contribute to its potential health benefits.
